notes: Setup wizard: Family and Calendar are separate steps, laid out like the Configurator – Your family (name, home address, each person with their colour and ⭐ Rewards) and Your calendar (the same colour coding and tidy-up as Screens → calendar page)

Setup wizard: Connect your display (XENEON EDGE on Windows, XENEON EDGE on a Raspberry Pi, a tablet, or a PC browser) and Connect your phones are separate steps. The phones step has a tab for each app saying what it is, the QR code, then how to install it and add it to the home screen on iPhone and Android
Setup wizard: Free API keys go one service at a time – Save and continue or Skip moves to the next, with your progress across the top and a back button
